name: csharp-best-practices
description: C# 14 best practices skill plugin with dotnet CLI agent.

interface.shortDescription: C# 14 best practices, MTP testing, and dotnet CLI workflows.
interface.longDescription: A collection of C#/.NET skills covering modern C# 14 language features, performance tuning, dotnet CLI operations, project initialization, test conventions, Microsoft Testing Platform runner and CI patterns, API and MongoDB integration testing with Verify and Testcontainers, MongoDB driver patterns, Aspire resources, Playwright E2E testing, Microsoft Agent Framework, and file-based apps.
defaultPrompt: Review this C# code against modern C# 14 best practices
Write integration tests for this API using Verify snapshots
Configure Microsoft Testing Platform and run the tests for this .NET solution
capabilities: Write and review C# code with modern C# 14 idioms
Run dotnet CLI builds, tests, and publishes with structured output
Configure Microsoft Testing Platform runners, extensions, and CI reporting
Design MongoDB, API, and Playwright E2E tests with Testcontainers and Verify
